# Wlad.me

> Personal site of Wlad, a senior UI engineer. Boring SaaS is a dated series of revenue notes on software products.

## Boring SaaS

- [Boring SaaS](https://www.wlad.me/blog): Index of editions and companies.
- [About these notes](https://www.wlad.me/blog/about): How Stripe-verified and self-reported labels work.

## Editions

- [Boring SaaS ideas for 29 September 2026](https://www.wlad.me/blog/2026-09-29): Revenue notes on 10 products for 29 September 2026. All 10 are labeled Stripe-verified. Each figure links to its source.
- [Boring SaaS ideas for 28 September 2026](https://www.wlad.me/blog/2026-09-28): Revenue notes on 9 products for 28 September 2026. 6 are labeled Stripe-verified and 3 are self-reported. Each figure links to its source.

## Companies

- [Anonymous workforce-management SaaS](https://www.wlad.me/blog/companies/anonymous-workforce-management-saas): Scheduling/time/compliance for employers.
- [Codédex](https://www.wlad.me/blog/companies/codedex): Gamified beginner coding + Club sub from ~$9.99/mo.
- [ControlResell](https://www.wlad.me/blog/companies/controlresell): Ops OS for pro resellers (Vinted, Shopify, etc.) — listings, negotiation, relisting, sales/purchase tracking. France-first.
- [DataExpert / TechCreator](https://www.wlad.me/blog/companies/dataexpert-techcreator): Data engineering + AI upskilling education (courses / community) at dataexpert.io — ~$119/mo.
- [Flocksy](https://www.wlad.me/blog/companies/flocksy): Flat-rate design/video subscription, ~$1,199–$2,999+/mo.
- [GESWORK](https://www.wlad.me/blog/companies/geswork): Modular management software for French service companies (ops / productivity suite).
- [Image-Charts](https://www.wlad.me/blog/companies/image-charts): Chart-as-image API for emails, PDFs, and chatbots (Google Image Charts spiritual successor). Bootstrapped since 2017.
- [Mon Atelier](https://www.wlad.me/blog/companies/mon-atelier): All-in-one ERP for French repair shops (phone, PC, appliance, bike): tickets, NF525 invoices, stock, POS, booking, QualiRépar, police ledger. From €19/mo. Solo founder, 48 shops.
- [MyCater](https://www.wlad.me/blog/companies/mycater): B2B catering marketplace for French companies — breakfast, lunch, events, cocktails — with ordering, invoicing, and curated caterers in one place.
- [MyFrank](https://www.wlad.me/blog/companies/myfrank): B2B SaaS that gamifies Google review collection per employee (QR codes, challenges, multi-location tracking). For sale per founder note.
- [MyPlots](https://www.wlad.me/blog/companies/myplots): Event discovery + ticketing, 20% + $1/ticket.
- [Plutio](https://www.wlad.me/blog/companies/plutio): All-in-one app for freelancers (projects, proposals, contracts, invoices, forms).
- [PROSP](https://www.wlad.me/blog/companies/prosp): LinkedIn outreach automation with AI personalization (prosp.ai); listed for sale on TrustMRR.
- [Salesrobot](https://www.wlad.me/blog/companies/salesrobot): LinkedIn + cold-email outreach automation.
- [Stan](https://www.wlad.me/blog/companies/stan): Creator storefront / “make a living online” platform (stan.store) — link-in-bio commerce for digital products and services.
- [Supademo](https://www.wlad.me/blog/companies/supademo): Interactive product demos for SaaS sales/onboarding.
- [Supliful](https://www.wlad.me/blog/companies/supliful): Private-label CPG + fulfillment for creators.
- [Tally](https://www.wlad.me/blog/companies/tally): Freemium form builder.
- [Windmill Growth](https://www.wlad.me/blog/companies/windmill-growth): Done-for-you personal branding / LinkedIn content service for B2B founders (~$3,999/mo retainers).
